title: Sticky budget table header
description: Add sticky positioning to the budget table header so column names remain visible when scrolling through many budget rows. Add 'sticky top-0 z-10 bg-background' classes to the TableHeader in budget-table.tsx.

title: Extract generic DatabaseRepository base class
description: Database repository implementations (DatabaseTransactionRepository, DatabaseBankTransactionRepository, DatabaseAccountRepository, etc.) duplicate the same boilerplate: insert → returning → map, findById, findMany patterns. Extract a generic DatabaseRepository<TEntity, TRow, TInsert> base class with shared methods (insertOne, findOneBy, findManyBy) so concrete repositories only define mapping and custom queries. DEFERRED: After analysis, repos are too heterogeneous (Transaction alone has 30+ unique methods) for a meaningful base class. Common patterns are simple 3-4 line methods — abstraction would add complexity without proportional value.
